description: <<- ignores an empty line when finding the common indentation
notes: The spec says the leading spaces of the literal text starting each line are analyzed and that the minimum is removed from every such line, without mentioning blank lines. hashicorp/hcl skips lines that contain only whitespace, both when finding the minimum and when removing it (flushHeredocTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go). Counting the empty line as having no leading spaces would remove nothing.
